heading: What you get
subhead: Everything follows the same workflow — design, paperwork, project.

designer.title: Window designer
designer.body: Dimensions, profiles, glass types, and hardware — the single source every document is built from.

paperwork.title: Paperwork, generated
paperwork.body: Quotes, spec sheets, and work orders, produced from the design instead of rebuilt around it.

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: Every job's status in one place, from first enquiry to the day it's delivered.

customers.title: Customers
customers.body: One record per customer, following them from enquiry through every project after.
